meta.what: Pre-authored boilerplate for NEW accounts — closers (open question + share-ask, name-free) and disclaimers (all five required elements). The scaffolder picks the first entry that shares no 5-word run with ANY live account's boilerplate, so an entry adopted by one account automatically stops being available to the next. The suite validates the whole bank against the live fleet on every run — bank rot fails CI, not onboarding day.
meta.elements: every disclaimer must carry: affiliate · commission/earn · medical advice · FDA · doctor/physician, and fit one tweet (≤280).
meta.added: 2026-08-24 (operator: 'new-account kit — one command builds an account's whole setup with its own unique wording')
